2: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah. Jehovah, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto thee.
3: Hide not thy face from me: in the day of my trouble, incline thine ear unto me; in the day I call, answer me speedily.
4: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a firebrand.
5: My heart is smitten and withered like grass; yea, I have forgotten to eat my bread.
6: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones cleave to my flesh.
7: I am become like the pelican of the wilderness, I am as an owl in desolate places;
8: I watch, and am like a sparrow alone upon the housetop.
9: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; they that are mad against me swear by me.
10: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
11: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath; for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
12: My days are like a lengthened-out shadow, and I, I am withered like grass.
13: But thou, Jehovah, abidest for ever, and thy memorial from generation to generation.
14: Thou wilt rise up, thou wilt have mercy upon Zion: for it is the time to be gracious to her, for the set time is come.
15: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour her dust.
16: And the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
17: When Jehovah shall build up Zion, he will appear in his glory.
18: He will regard the prayer of the destitute one, and not despise their prayer.
19: This shall be written for the generation to come; and a people that shall be created shall praise Jah:
20: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from the heavens hath Jehovah beheld the earth,
21: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, to loose those that are appointed to die;
22: That the name of Jehovah may be declared in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
23: When the peoples shall be gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.
24: He weakened my strength in the way, he shortened my days.
25: I said, MyGod, take me not away in the midst of my days!...Thy years are from generation to generation.
26: Of old hast thou founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of thy hands:
27: They shall perish, but thou continuest; and all of them shall grow old as a garment: as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed.
28: But thou art the Same, and thy years shall have no end.
29: The children of thy servants shall abide, and their seed shall be established before thee.
